name: Coffee Talk Tokyo
source:
In a city of paper and steel, as large as a country, a small café gives humans and fantasy people a cosy place to be. Brew the right order for your customers as they seek refuge from the sweltering Tokyo summer heat and share heartfelt stories to chill lo-fi beats.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161220/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一座由纸张与钢铁筑成、幅员堪比一国之广的巨型都市里，一间小小咖啡馆为人类与奇幻种族提供了一处温馨惬意的落脚之地。当顾客们躲进店里避开东京酷热的盛夏暑气时，伴着慵懒治愈的Lo-Fi节拍，为他们冲调恰到好处的饮品，倾听一段段真挚动人的心声故事吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161220/]Steam[/url]]
